findings.title: The extensions empty value conflicts between prose and schema
evidence: docs/implementation/contracts/exchange-and-query.md:26 says v1.0.0 extensions is an empty object.
schemas/quick_scan/exchange.schema.json at $defs.ExchangePackage.properties.extensions requires an array with maxItems 0.
scripts/exchange_contract.py build_package emits extensions as an empty array.
findings.impact: A producer following the contract prose emits {} and fails the published schema; the reference producer emits [] instead.
findings.recommended_resolution: Change the prose to specify an empty array ([]), then keep the schema and helper aligned.
